en: Clear sky this morning. Anyone driving east is doing it from memory.
Not a cloud all day. The only tree in the car park is now prime property.
Mostly sunny. Except over your garden.
It's looked like rain since breakfast. Still just looking.
The sun didn't show for sundowners. Everyone else did.
Steady breeze from next door's braai. You get everything but the meat.
A proper breeze tonight. The mosquitoes have been grounded.
Good rain. Oupa's already phoning round: 'How much did you get?'
Raining all night. The sprinkler hasn't noticed.
In and out of the sun all day, then this. We all know someone like that.
